{{Top|leg}}
'''Hemosponge''' was a specialized medical sponge used by the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was designed to soak up leaking [[Blood/Legends|blood]] during field surgeries so as to minimize visual distractions.
